command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(infile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
needed <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
missing_cols <- setdiff(needed, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
fit_data <- d[!is.na(d$Efficacy) & !is.na(d$BMI), c("Efficacy", "BMI")]
fit_data$BMI <- as.numeric(fit_data$BMI)
fit_data <- fit_data[!is.na(fit_data$BMI), ]
fit_data$PR_event <- as.integer(fit_data$Efficacy == "PR")
if (length(unique(fit_data$PR_event)) < 2) {
  stop("Binary response has fewer than two observed classes after filtering")
}
model <- glm(PR_event ~ BMI, data = fit_data, family = binomial())
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n", "events_PR", "non_events"),
  value = c(format(AIC(model), digits = 15, scientific = FALSE),
            as.character(nrow(fit_data)),
            as.character(sum(fit_data$PR_event == 1)),
            as.character(sum(fit_data$PR_event == 0)))
)
write.table(result, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
